items.title: Response Rule
items.markdownDescription:
Response rule configuration.

**Fields:**
- **name**: Name of the response rule.
- **description**: Description of the response rule. Optional.
- **enabled**: Control whether the response rule is enabled or disabled. 

 - `true` the rule will be applied. 

 - `false` the rule will be always ignored.
- **operator**: Operator to use for combining conditions in the rule.
- **conditions**: Array of conditions to check against the request headers. Conditions are applied with **operator**. If conditions are empty, the rule will be matched.
- **responseType**: Type of the response. Determines the type of **response** to be returned when the rule is matched.
- **responseModifications**: Response modifications to be applied when the rule is matched. Optional.

**Example:**
```json
{
  "name": "Block Legacy Clients",
  "description": "Block requests from legacy clients",
  "enabled": true,
  "operator": "OR",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "headerName": "user-agent",
      "operator": "CONTAINS",
      "value": "Hiddify",
      "caseSensitive": true
    },
    {
      "headerName": "user-agent",
      "operator": "CONTAINS",
      "value": "FoxRay",
      "caseSensitive": true
    }
  ],
  "responseType": "BLOCK"
}
```

If you set this flag to **true**, headers from SRR will be added at the very end, just before the response is sent. In this case, SRR headers may override headers from other sections.

subscriptionTemplate.markdownDescription: Override the subscription template with the given name. If not provided, the default subscription template will be used. ignoreHostXrayJsonTemplate.markdownDescription: Each Host may have its own Xray Json Template. If you set this flag to **true**, the Xray Json Template defined by the SRR will be used. **The Host's Xray Json Template will be ignored.**

ignoreServeJsonAtBaseSubscription.title: Ignore Serve Json at Base Subscription

**Default Mihomo extended clients:**

- `^prizrak-box/`

**Default Xray extended clients:**

excludeHostsByTags.title: Exclude Hosts by Tags

respondWithRemarks.title: Respond With Remarks
respondWithRemarks.markdownDescription: Replaces the response body with the provided remarks. If this array contains more than one element, actual hosts will not be sent.

items.title: Response Rule
items.markdownDescription:
Response rule configuration.

**Fields:**
- **name**: Name of the response rule.
- **description**: Description of the response rule. Optional.
- **enabled**: Control whether the response rule is enabled or disabled. 

 - `true` the rule will be applied. 

 - `false` the rule will be always ignored.
- **operator**: Operator to use for combining conditions in the rule.
- **conditions**: Array of conditions to check against the request headers. Conditions are applied with **operator**. If conditions are empty, the rule will be matched.
- **responseType**: Type of the response. Determines the type of **response** to be returned when the rule is matched.
- **responseModifications**: Response modifications to be applied when the rule is matched. Optional.

**Example:**
```json
{
  "name": "Block Legacy Clients",
  "description": "Block requests from legacy clients",
  "enabled": true,
  "operator": "OR",
  "conditions": [
    {
      "headerName": "user-agent",
      "operator": "CONTAINS",
      "value": "Hiddify",
      "caseSensitive": true
    },
    {
      "headerName": "user-agent",
      "operator": "CONTAINS",
      "value": "FoxRay",
      "caseSensitive": true
    }
  ],
  "responseType": "BLOCK"
}
```

defaultSnippets.label: Examples: Blank rule
defaultSnippets.markdownDescription:
Simple blank rule with no conditions or modifications.
```json
{
  "name": "Blank rule",
  "description": "Blank rule",
  "operator": "AND",
  "enabled": true,
  "conditions": [],
  "responseType": "BLOCK",
  "responseModifications": {
    "headers": []
  }
}
```

rules.title: Response Rules
rules.markdownDescription:
Array of **response rules**. Rules are evaluated in order and the first rule that matches is applied. If no rule matches, request will be blocked by default.

**Example:**
```json
[
  {
    "name": "Blank rule",
    "description": "Blank rule",
    "operator": "AND",
    "enabled": true,
    "conditions": [],
    "responseType": "BLOCK",
    "responseModifications": {
      "headers": []

  }
]
```
